Workshop loader only: move BepInEx/patchers/TailsideWorkshopModLoader.dll outside BepInEx. BepInEx and regular plugins remain installed.

For the standard Windows BepInEx installation used here: move the BepInEx-provided winhttp.dll outside the game folder to stop BepInEx loading. Keep it so you can restore it later. Do not move an unknown DLL.

To remove the remaining BepInEx files, first back up any mods and settings you want to keep, then remove only files you know you installed. This is not a general uninstaller for other loaders or hardpatched game files.

If you keep regular plugins after removing only this loader, set HideManagerGameObject=true in BepInEx/config/BepInEx.cfg.

If an installation record is damaged, use a trusted backup or ask for help. This tool will not guess which files it owns.
